deviations.problem: Frozen expanded-period Q5 and benchmark holdings crossed PLAY's December 2020 terminal event, which was absent from the five-row accepted exit audit and left expanded NAV unresolved.
deviations.correction: Apply one PLN 39.00 cash takeover on 2020-12-23 using official Iliad announcement and squeeze-out notice; do not change signal, schedules, weighting, costs, periods, or gates.
deviations.effect_on_v1: Expanded-period economics in v1 are invalid and must not be used. Common-period results and all frozen strategy semantics are unchanged.

deviations.problem: The v2 preflight treated 2020-12-22 as an executable PLAY session. The pinned candidate has no source-native open or close that day, so expanded offset 10 could not execute its frozen zero target and remained unresolved even though the cash action was known.
deviations.correction: Record 2020-12-21 as the last observed native-price session, block fabricated fills from 2020-12-22, and apply the unchanged official PLN 39.00 cash action on 2020-12-23. Do not change signal, schedules, weighting, costs, periods, or gates.
deviations.effect_on_v2: Expanded-period economics in v2 are invalid and must not be used. Common-period results and all frozen strategy semantics are unchanged.

deviations.problem: The v3 final cohort had no explicit zero target at its valid exact t+20 endpoint, so 114 of 120 sleeves could retain holdings for as many as 19 additional sessions. CAGR and turnover were annualized over resolved NAV observations rather than the shared declared elapsed-session span.
deviations.correction: Add one explicit terminal liquidation at the final valid cohort's exact t+20 source-native open, set every previously targeted security to zero, remain fully in cash through period end, and annualize CAGR and turnover over all declared elapsed sessions while retaining resolved-session counts as diagnostics.
deviations.effect_on_v3: All v3 economic metrics and the v3 final verdict are superseded. Signal, periods, offsets, costs, weighting, event terms, and economic hurdles remain unchanged.
